**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What You Need | How It Works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | The round ends when a player discards their last card. The other players add up the values of the cards they still hold; those totals become the points that the winner receives. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each + 8 Wild cards (4 Wild, 4 Wild Draw Four). | Shuffle the deck thoroughly. | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Wild Draw Four, the next player draws four cards and loses a turn). | The first player to the left of the dealer starts. | | **Card Types** | 1. **Number cards** (0‑9).
2. **Action cards**: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two.
3. **Wild cards**: Wild, Wild Draw Four. | • Number cards match by color or number.
• Action cards match by color or type.
• Wild cards can be played on any card; the player declares the new color. | | **Turn Flow** | 1. **Draw**: If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends.
2. **Play**: Place one card from your hand onto the discard pile that matches the top card by color, number, or type. If you play a Wild, declare the new color.
3. **Special actions**: Apply the effect of any action card you just played (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild Draw Four). | If you play a Wild Draw Four, the next player must draw four cards and lose a turn unless they challenge you. | | **Challenges** | If a player believes a Wild Draw Four was played illegally (i.e., the player had a matching color card), they can challenge.
• If the challenger is correct, the original player draws four cards.
• If the challenger is wrong, the challenger draws six cards. | Only one challenge per Wild Draw Four. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all seven cards wins the round. | The winner scores points equal to the sum of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Scoring** | • Number cards: face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each. | Add up the points from the round. The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | | **House Variations** | • **“Uno” shout**: Players must say “UNO” when they have one card left; failure to do so results in a penalty (draw two).
• **“Draw 4” penalty**: Some groups allow a player to draw four cards if they cannot play any card, even if they have a matching color.
• **“Reverse” on two players**: Reverse acts like Skip. | Adjust the rules to fit your group’s preferences. | --- ### Quick Play Tips 1. **Keep a balanced hand** – try to have a mix of colors and numbers to avoid being stuck. 2. **Use action cards strategically** – playing a Draw Two or Skip right after a Wild can swing the game. 3. **Watch opponents’ colors** – if you see someone playing a Wild, note the color they switch to; it may give you a clue about their hand. 4. **Challenge wisely** – only challenge if you’re fairly certain the Wild Draw Four was illegal; the penalty for a wrong challenge is steep. Enjoy your game!
